170:         &&& self.rid@ == replica.spec_id()
171:         &&& self.fc_client@.instance_id() == replica.flat_combiner_instance@.id()

491: /// The ghost context for a thread carying permissions and tracking the state of the update operation
492: ///
493: ///  - Dafny:   glinear datatype ContextGhost = ContextGhost(
494: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
495:     /// Token to access the batch cell in Context
496:     ///
497:     ///  - Dafny: glinear contents: glOption<CellContents<OpResponse>>,
498:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
499:

501:     ///
502:     ///  - Dafny: glinear fc: FCSlot,
503:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
504: 
505:     /// tracks the update operation
506:     ///
507:     ///  - Dafny: glinear update: glOption<Update>
508:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
509: }

511: //  - Dafny: predicate inv(v: uint64, i: nat, cell: Cell<OpResponse>, fc_loc_s: nat)
512: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
513:     predicate {
514:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
515:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
516: 
517:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
518:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
519:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
520: 
521:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
522:             &&& self.update.is_none()
523:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
524:         })
525: 
526:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
527:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
528:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
529:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
530:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
531: 
532:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
533:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
534:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
535:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
536:         })
537: 
538:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
539:             &&& self.update.is_none()
540:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
541:         })
542: 
543:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
544:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
545:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
546:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
547:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
548: 
549:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
550:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
551:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
552:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
553:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
554:         })
555:     }
556: }
557: }  // struct_with_invariants! ContextGhost

578:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()

1674:     /// Advances the head of the log forward. If a replica has stopped making
1675:     /// progress, then this method will never return. Accepts a closure that is
1676:     /// passed into execute() to ensure that this replica does not deadlock GC.
1677:     #[inline(always)]
1678:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
1679:     fn advance_head(
1680:         &self,
1681:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1682:         // the following were part of the closure
1683:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1684:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1685:         // ghost state for execute etc.
1686:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1687:     ) -> (res: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)
1688:         requires
1689:             self.wf(),
1690:             replica_token.wf(self.num_replicas@),
1691:             ghost_data@.advance_head_pre(
1692:                 replica_token.id_spec(),
1693:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1694:                 old(responses)@,
1695:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1696:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1697:             ),
1698:         ensures
1699:             res@.advance_head_post(
1700:                 ghost_data@,
1701:                 replica_token.id_spec(),
1702:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1703:                 final(responses)@,
1704:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1705:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1706:             ),
1707:     {
1708:         let mut ghost_data_new = ghost_data;
1709:         let mut iteration = 1;
1710:         loop
1711:             invariant
1712:                 self.wf(),
1713:                 replica_token.wf(self.num_replicas@),
1714:                 ghost_data_new@.cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1715:                 ghost_data_new@.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> ghost_data_new@.pre_exec(
1716:                     responses@,
1717:                 ),
1718:                 ghost_data_new@.advance_head_post(
1719:                     ghost_data@,
1720:                     replica_token.id_spec(),
1721:                     actual_replica.view(),
1722:                     responses@,
1723:                     self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1724:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1725:                 ),
1726:                 0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1727:         {
1728:             let Tracked(ghost_data0) = ghost_data_new;
1729:             let tracked NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1730:                 local_updates,
1731:                 ghost_replica,
1732:                 combiner,
1733:                 cb_combiner,
1734:                 request_ids,
1735:             } = ghost_data0;
1736:             let tracked mut cb_combiner = cb_combiner.get();
1737:             // let global_head = self.head.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1738:             let global_head =
1739:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1740:                 &self.head.0 => load();
1741:                 returning ret;
1742:                 ghost g => { /* no-op */ }
1743:             );
1744:             // let f = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1745:             let global_tail =
1746:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1747:                 &self.tail.0 => load();
1748:                 returning ret;
1749:                 ghost g => { /* no-op */ }
1750:             );
1751:             let (min_local_version, cb_combiner0) = self.find_min_local_version(
1752:                 Tracked(cb_combiner),
1753:             );
1754:             let tracked mut cb_combiner = cb_combiner0.get();
1755:             // If we cannot advance the head further, then start
1756:             // from the beginning of this loop again. Before doing so, try consuming
1757:             // any new entries on the log to prevent deadlock.
1758:             if min_local_version == global_head {
1759:                 proof {
1760:                     cb_combiner =
1761:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().advance_head_abort(
1762:                         replica_token.id_spec(),
1763:                         cb_combiner,
1764:                     );
1765:                 }
1766:                 if iteration == WARN_THRESHOLD {
1767:                     print_starvation_warning(line!());
1768:                     // let tracked cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1769:                     // let tracked ghost_data = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost { local_updates, ghost_replica, combiner, cb_combiner, request_ids };
1770:                     // return Tracked(ghost_data);
1771:                     iteration = 0;
1772:                 }
1773:                 let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1774:                 let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1775:                     local_updates,
1776:                     ghost_replica,
1777:                     combiner,
1778:                     cb_combiner,
1779:                     request_ids,
1780:                 };
1781:                 ghost_data_new =
1782:                 self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));
1783:                 continue ;
1784:             }
1785:             // There are entries that can be freed up; update the head offset.
1786:             // self.head.store(min_local_tail, Ordering::Relaxed);
1787: 
1788:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1789:                 &self.head.0 => store(min_local_version);
1790:                 update old_val -> new_val;
1791:                 ghost g => {
1792:                     cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().advance_head_finish(replica_token.id_spec(), &mut g, cb_combiner);
1793:             });
1794:             if global_tail < min_local_version + self.slog.len() as u64 - GC_FROM_HEAD as u64 {
1795:                 let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1796:                 let tracked ghost_data_new = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1797:                     local_updates,
1798:                     ghost_replica,
1799:                     combiner,
1800:                     cb_combiner,
1801:                     request_ids,
1802:                 };
1803:                 return Tracked(ghost_data_new);
1804:             }
1805:             let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1806:             let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1807:                 local_updates,
1808:                 ghost_replica,
1809:                 combiner,
1810:                 cb_combiner,
1811:                 request_ids,
1812:             };
1813:             // replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1814:             ghost_data_new =
1815:             self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));
1816:         }
1817:     }

1854:     /// Executes a passed in closure (`d`) on all operations starting from a
1855:     /// replica's local tail on the shared log. The replica is identified
1856:     /// through an `idx` passed in as an argument.
1857:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
1858:     pub(crate) fn execute(
1859:         &self,
1860:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1861:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1862:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1863:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1864:     ) -> (result: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)
1865:         requires
1866:             self.wf(),
1867:             replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1868:             ghost_data@.execute_pre(
1869:                 replica_token@,
1870:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1871:                 old(responses)@,
1872:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1873:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1874:             ),
1875:         ensures
1876:             result@.execute_post(
1877:                 ghost_data@,
1878:                 replica_token@,
1879:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1880:                 old(responses)@,
1881:                 final(responses)@,
1882:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1883:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1884:             ),
1885:     {
1886:         let nid = replica_token.id() as usize;
1887:         // somehow can't really do this as a destructor
1888:         let tracked ghost_data = ghost_data.get();
1889:         // let tracked Tracked(ghost_data) = ghost_data;  // XXX: that one here doesn't work?
1890:         let tracked mut local_updates = ghost_data.local_updates.get();  // Tracked::<Map<ReqId, UnboundedLog::local_updates>>,
1891:         let tracked mut ghost_replica = ghost_data.ghost_replica.get();  // Tracked<UnboundedLog::replicas>,
1892:         let tracked mut combiner = ghost_data.combiner.get();  // Tracked<UnboundedLog::combiner>,
1893:         let tracked mut cb_combiner = ghost_data.cb_combiner.get();  // Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner>,
1894:         let ghost request_ids = ghost_data.request_ids@;  // Ghost<Seq<ReqId>>,
1895:         let ghost mut request_ids_new = request_ids;
1896:         proof {
1897:             // if the combiner in idle, we start it with the trival start transition
1898:             if combiner.value().is_Ready() {
1899:                 combiner =
1900:                 self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_trivial_start(nid as nat, combiner);
1901:                 request_ids_new = Seq::empty();
1902:             }
1903:         }
1904:         // let ltail = self.ltails[idx.0 - 1].load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1905:         let mut local_version =
1906:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1907:             &self.local_versions[nid].0 => load();
1908:             returning ret;
1909:             ghost g => {
1910:                 // this kicks of the state transition in both the cyclic buffer and the unbounded log
1911:                 combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_load_local_version(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1912:                 cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_start(nid as nat, &g.1, cb_combiner);
1913:             }
1914:         );
1915:         // Check if we have any work to do by comparing our local tail with the log's
1916:         // global tail. If they're equal, then we're done here and can simply return.
1917:         // let gtail = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1918:         let global_tail =
1919:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1920:             &self.tail.0 => load();
1921:             returning global_tail;
1922:             ghost g => {
1923:                 if (local_version == global_tail) {
1924:                     // there has ben no additional updates to be applied, combiner back to idle
1925:                     combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_finish_no_change(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1926:                     cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_abort(nid as nat, cb_combiner);
1927:                 } else {
1928:                     combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_load_global_head(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1929:                     cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_enter(nid as nat,  &g.1, cb_combiner);
1930:                 }
1931:             }
1932:         );
1933:         if local_version == global_tail {

2787: pub open spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
2788: 
2789:     predicate {
2790:         &&& (forall |i: int| 0 <= i < self.contexts.len() ==> (#[trigger] self.contexts[i]).wf(i as nat))
2791:         &&& (forall |i: nat| 0 <= i < self.contexts.len() ==> (#[trigger] self.contexts[i as int]).flat_combiner_instance == self.flat_combiner_instance)
2792:         &&& (forall |i: nat| 0 <= i < self.contexts.len() ==> (#[trigger] self.contexts[i as int]).unbounded_log_instance == self.unbounded_log_instance)
2793: 
2794:         &&& self.replica_token.rid < self.unbounded_log_instance@.num_replicas()
2795: 
2796:         &&& self.contexts.len() == MAX_THREADS_PER_REPLICA
2797:         &&& self.data.0.max_threads() == self.contexts.len()
2798:         &&& 0 <= self.spec_id() < MAX_REPLICAS
2799:         &&& self.data.0.wf()
2800:         &&& (forall |v: ReplicatedDataStructure<DT>| (#[trigger] self.data.0.inv(v)) == v.wf(self.spec_id(), self.unbounded_log_instance@, self.cyclic_buffer_instance@))
2801: 
2802:         &&& self.flat_combiner_instance@.num_threads() == MAX_THREADS_PER_REPLICA
2803:         &&& (forall |i| #![trigger self.thread_tokens[i]] 0 <= i < self.thread_tokens.len() ==> {
2804:             self.thread_tokens[i].wf(self)
2805:         })
2806:     }
2807: 
2808:     invariant on combiner with (flat_combiner_instance, responses, collected_operations, collected_operations_per_thread) specifically (self.combiner.0) is (v: u64, g: Option<CombinerLockStateGhost<DT>>) {
2809:         // v != 0 means lock is not taken, if it's not taken, the ghost state is Some
2810:         &&& (v == 0) <==> g.is_some()
2811:         //
2812:         &&& (g matches Some(g) ==> g.inv(flat_combiner_instance@, responses.id(), collected_operations.id(), collected_operations_per_thread.id()))
2813:     }
2814: 
2815:     // invariant on num_threads with (flat_combiner_instance) specifically (self.num_threads.0)  is (v: u64, g: Tracked<u64>) {
2816:     //     v == g@
2817:     // }
2818: }

5777: // Simple Log

5795: /// Tracks the progress of a read-only query on the data structure.

5798: /// being read. That version defines the state the data structure is queried against.
5799: ///
5800: /// Readonly operations are carried out in two steps:
5801: ///  1. When a 'ReadReq' request begins record the version of the log.
5802: ///  2. When it ends, we must return the answer at some version >= the recorded value.
5803: ///
5804: pub ghost enum ReadReq<R> {
5805:     /// a new read request that has entered the system
5806:     Init { op: R },
5807:     /// a request that has been dispatched at a specific version
5808:     Req { version: LogIdx, op: R },
5809: }

5812:     /// Extracts the operation from the ReadReq
5813:     pub open spec fn op(self) -> R {
5814:         match self {
5815:             ReadReq::Init { op } => op,
5816:             ReadReq::Req { op, .. } => op,
5817:         }
5818:     }
5819: }
5820: 
5821: /// Tracks the progress of an update query on the data structure.
5822: ///
5823: /// Update requests are placed into the log. The
5824: pub ghost struct UpdateResp(pub LogIdx);

5826: state_machine! {
5827:     SimpleLog<DT: Dispatch> {
5828:     fields {
5829:         /// a sequence of update operations,
5830:         pub log: Seq<DT::WriteOperation>,
5831:         /// the completion tail current index into the log
5832:         pub version: LogIdx,
5833:         /// in flight read requests
5834:         pub readonly_reqs: Map<ReqId, ReadReq<DT::ReadOperation>>,
5835:         /// inflight update requests
5836:         pub update_reqs: Map<ReqId, DT::WriteOperation>,
5837:         /// responses to update requests that haven't been returned
5838:         pub update_resps: Map<ReqId, UpdateResp>,

5845:     // Invariant
5846:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

5848: 
5849:     /// the version of the log must be less than the length of the log
5850:     #[invariant]
5851:     pub fn inv_version(&self) -> bool {

5854: 
5855:     /// all update responses must have version that are less than the length of the log

5858:         forall |rid: ReqId| #[trigger] self.update_resps.contains_key(rid)

5863:     #[invariant]
5864:     pub fn inv_readonly_req_version(&self) -> bool {
5865:         forall |rid: ReqId| #[trigger] self.readonly_reqs.contains_key(rid) && self.readonly_reqs[rid] is Req

5871:     // State Machine Initialization
5872:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5873: 
5874: 
5875:     init!{
5876:         initialize() {

5878:             init version = 0;
5879:             init readonly_reqs = Map::empty();
5880:             init update_reqs = Map::empty();
5881:             init update_resps = Map::empty();

5883:     }

5886:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5887:     // Constructing the DataStructureSpec
5888:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5889: 
5890: 
5891:     /// constructs the state of the data structure at a specific version given the log
5892:     ///

5894:     /// data structure and returns the state of the data structure at the given  version.

5896:         recommends 0 <= version <= self.log.len()

5902:     // Read Operation Transitions
5903:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5904: 
5905: 
5906:     /// Read Request: Enter the read request operation into the system
5907:     ///
5908:     /// The supplied request id must not yet be know to the system
5909:     transition!{
5910:         readonly_start(label: Label<DT>, rid: ReqId, op: DT::ReadOperation) {
5911:             require label == AsyncLabel::<DT>::Start(rid, InputOperation::Read(op));
5912: 
5913:             require !pre.readonly_reqs.contains_key(rid);
5914:             require !pre.update_reqs.contains_key(rid);
5915:             require !pre.update_resps.contains_key(rid);

5917:             update readonly_reqs[rid] = ReadReq::<DT::ReadOperation>::Init{ op };
5918:         }
5919:     }

5921:     /// Read Request: Read the current version of the log
5922:     ///

5924:     transition!{
5925:         readonly_read_version(label: Label<DT>, rid: ReqId) {
5926:             require label.is_Internal();
5927: 
5928:             require pre.readonly_reqs.contains_key(rid);
5929:             require let ReadReq::<DT::ReadOperation>::Init { op } = pre.readonly_reqs[rid];

5931:             update readonly_reqs[rid] = ReadReq::<DT::ReadOperation>::Req { op, version: pre.version };
5932:         }
5933:     }
5934: 
5935:     /// Read Request: Remove the request from the system
5936:     ///
5937:     /// The actual version at which the read request was executed may be newer than when the
5938:     /// read request entered the system. Thus, the supplied version must be larger or equal to
5939:     /// the version that was read before, and less or equal to the current current length of the log.
5940:     transition!{
5941:         readonly_finish(label: Label<DT>, rid: ReqId, version: LogIdx, ret: DT::Response) {
5942:             require label == AsyncLabel::<DT>::End(rid, OutputOperation::Read(ret));

5944:             require pre.readonly_reqs.contains_key(rid);

5947:             require current <= version <= pre.log.len();

5953:     }

5955: 
5956:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5957:     // Update Operation Transitions
5958:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5959: 
5960: 
5961:     // Update operation happen in four steps:
5962:     //  1. add the update to the local update requests
5963:     //  2. collect the updates and store them in the log
5964:     //  3. increase the version of the log
5965:     //  4. return the version of the log at the update

5973:             require label == AsyncLabel::<DT>::Start(rid, InputOperation::Write(op));
5974: 
5975:             require !pre.readonly_reqs.contains_key(rid);
5976:             require !pre.update_reqs.contains_key(rid);
5977:             require !pre.update_resps.contains_key(rid);

5980:         }
5981:     }
5982: 
5983:     /// Update Request: Add the update operations to the log

5986:     /// The update moves from the requests to the responses and the log grows by one element.

5988:         update_add_op_to_log(label: Label<DT>, rid: ReqId) {

5990: 
5991:             require pre.update_reqs.contains_key(rid);

5993:             update log = pre.log.push(pre.update_reqs[rid]);
5994:             update update_reqs = pre.update_reqs.remove(rid);

5999:     /// Update: Increasing the version of the log
6000:     ///
6001:     /// The version value is monotonically increasing and must not be larger than the
6002:     /// length of the log.

6004:         update_incr_version(label: Label<DT>, new_version: LogIdx) {

6009:             update version = new_version;

6011:     }
6012: 
6013:     /// Update: Finish the update operation

6015:     /// This removes the update response from the update responses. The supplied return value
6016:     /// must match the value when we apply the update to the data structure at the give version.
6017:     transition!{
6018:         update_finish(label: Label<DT>, rid: nat, ret: DT::Response) {
6019:             require label == AsyncLabel::<DT>::End(rid, OutputOperation::Write(ret));
6020: 
6021:             require pre.update_resps.contains_key(rid);
6022:             let uidx = pre.update_resps[rid].0;
6023: 
6024:             require uidx < pre.version <= pre.log.len();

6027:             update update_resps = pre.update_resps.remove(rid);
6028:         }
6029:     }

6031: 
6032:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6033:     // Stutter Step
6034:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6035: 
6036: 
6037:     /// No-Op transition

6039:         no_op(label: Label<DT>, ) {

6041:         }
6042:     }

6134: // Unbounded Log

6137: // The UnboundedLog is the first Refinement of the SimpleLog. As its name suggests, it also uses
6138: // an unbounded log to represent updates to the data structure, however the log itself is represented
6139: // by a map instead of a sequence. Moreover, the state machine also manages the data structure

6141: //
6142: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6143: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6144: // Read Only Operations
6145: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6146: /// ReadonlyState: Tracking the progress of read-only queries
6147: ///
6148: /// Used to track the progress of a read-only queries on the data structure.
6149: ///
6150: /// A readonly query takes place on a given node (`nid`), and follows the following algorithm:
6151: ///
6152: ///  1. Read the global value 'version_upper_bound'.
6153: ///  2. Wait until node-local value 'local_head' is greater than the value
6154: ///     of 'version_upper_bound' that was read in step 1.
6155: ///  3. Execute the query against the node-local replica and return the result.
6156: ///
6157: /// (In real life, the thread does not just sit around 'waiting' in step 2;
6158: /// it might run a combiner phase in order to advance the local_head.)
6159: ///
6160: /// These 3 steps progress the status of the request through the cycle
6161: ///    Init -> VersionUpperBound -> ReadyToRead -> Done
6162: ///
6163: /// Note that the request itself does not "care" which nodeId it takes place on;
6164: /// we only track the nodeId to make sure that steps 2 and 3 use the same node.
6165: ///
6166: #[is_variant]
6167: pub ghost enum ReadonlyState<DT: Dispatch> {
6168:     /// a new read request that has come in
6169:     Init { op: DT::ReadOperation },
6170:     /// has read the version upper bound value
6171:     VersionUpperBound { op: DT::ReadOperation, version_upper_bound: LogIdx },
6172:     /// ready to read
6173:     ReadyToRead { op: DT::ReadOperation, version_upper_bound: LogIdx, node_id: NodeId },
6174:     /// read request is done
6175:     Done { op: DT::ReadOperation, version_upper_bound: LogIdx, node_id: NodeId, ret: DT::Response },
6176: }
6177: 
6178: impl<DT: Dispatch> ReadonlyState<DT> {
6179:     pub open spec fn op(self) -> DT::ReadOperation {
6180:         match self {
6181:             ReadonlyState::Init { op, .. } => op,
6182:             ReadonlyState::VersionUpperBound { op, .. } => op,
6183:             ReadonlyState::ReadyToRead { op, .. } => op,
6184:             ReadonlyState::Done { op, .. } => op,
6185:         }
6186:     }
6187: }
6188: 
6189: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6190: // Update Operation
6191: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6192: ////////// Updates and the combiner phase
6193: //
6194: // This part is a lot more complex; the lifecycle of an "update" is inherently
6195: // tied to the lifecycle of the combiner, so I have to explain the entire combiner
6196: // cycle for this to make sense.
6197: //

6199: // of Update requests, which all start in UpdateState::Init.

6222: //      for the cycle will be contiguous in the log.

6856:             add combiner      += [ node_id => CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion: lversion + 1, tail, idx: idx + 1}];
6857:         }
6858:     }
6859: 
6860:     /// Combiner: dispatch a remote update and apply it to the local replica
6861:     transition!{
6862:         exec_dispatch_remote(node_id: NodeId) {
6863:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState:: Loop { queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx } ];
6864:             remove replicas -= [ node_id => let old_nr_state ];
6865: 
6866:             have   log      >= [ lversion => let log_entry ];
6867: 
6868:             // apply all updates between lhead and global tail that were enqueued from remote nodes
6869:             require(lversion < tail);
6870:             require(log_entry.node_id != node_id);
6871:             let (new_nr_state, ret) = DT::dispatch_mut_spec(old_nr_state, log_entry.op);
6872: 
6873:             add replicas    += [ node_id => new_nr_state ];
6874:             add combiner    += [ node_id => CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion: lversion + 1, tail, idx}];
6875:         }
6876:     }
6877: 
6878:     /// Combiner: Safety condition, if we applied all updates, idx must be the length of the list
6879:     property!{
6880:         pre_exec_update_version_upper_bound(node_id: NodeId) {
6881:             have combiner >= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Loop{ queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx } ];
6882: 
6883:             require(lversion == tail);
6884:             assert(idx == queued_ops.len()) by {
6885:                 // assert(pre.wf_combiner_for_node_id(node_id));
6886:                 // assert(lversion == tail);
6887:             };
6888:         }
6889:     }
6890: 
6891:     /// Combiner: update the version upper bound when all updates have been applied to the local replica
6892:     transition!{
6893:         exec_update_version_upper_bound(node_id: NodeId) {
6894:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx, }];
6895: 
6896:             // we applied all updates up to the global tail we've read
6897:             require(lversion == tail);
6898: 
6899:             // assert(idx == queued_ops.len()) by {
6900:             //     //assert(pre.wf_combiner_for_node_id(node_id));
6901:             // };
6902: 
6903:             update version_upper_bound = if pre.version_upper_bound >= tail {
6904:                 pre.version_upper_bound
6905:             } else {
6906:                 tail
6907:             };
6908:             add combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::UpdatedVersion { queued_ops, tail } ];
6909:         }
6910:     }
6911: 
6912:     /// Combiner: is done, bump the local version and combiner returns to ready state
6913:     transition!{
6914:         exec_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
6915:             remove combiner       -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::UpdatedVersion { queued_ops, tail } ];
6916:             remove local_versions -= [ node_id => let old_local_head ];
6917: 
6918:             // here have the local updates updated to done.
6919: 
6920:             add    local_versions += [ node_id => tail ];
6921:             add    combiner       += [ node_id => CombinerState::Ready ];
6922:         }
6923:     }
6924: 
6925:     /// Combiner: is done, without any change
6926:     transition!{
6927:         exec_finish_no_change(node_id: NodeId) {
6928:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::LoadedLocalVersion { queued_ops, lversion } ];
6929: 
6930:             require(lversion == pre.tail);
6931:             assert(queued_ops.len() == 0);
6932: 
6933:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Ready];
6934:         }
6935:     }

7221:         recommends self.combiner.contains_key(node_id) && self.local_versions.contains_key(node_id)

7226:             CombinerState::LoadedLocalVersion{ lversion, .. } => lversion,
7227:             CombinerState::Loop { lversion, .. }              => lversion,
7228:             CombinerState::UpdatedVersion { tail, .. }        => tail,
7229:         }
7230:     }
